title: Why Prices End in .99 #shorts
description:
Prices ending in 9 are everywhere: a 1997 study found around 60% of advertised prices ended in 9. Researchers call one explanation the left-digit effect: the brain reads $3.99 as 'three something' rather than nearly four. The popular story that .99 pricing was invented to force cashiers to open the register is a common claim, but its origin is unclear.

Question: do you fall for .99 prices? Tell me in the comments.

Made with AI assistance (research, voice and artwork). Events are simplified for storytelling.
